import z3
from itertools import combinations

def find_and_check():
    n = 24
    edges = {}
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            edges[(i,j)] = z3.Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}")
    
    solver = z3.Solver()
    
    # Degree constraints
    for i in range(n):
        incident = [edges[(min(i,j), max(i,j))] for j in range(n) if j != i]
        solver.add(z3.PbGe([(v, 1) for v in incident], 3))
        solver.add(z3.PbLe([(v, 1) for v in incident], 6))
    
    # No 3-cycles
    for i,j,k in combinations(range(n), 3):
        solver.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,j)], edges[(j,k)], edges[(i,k)])))
    
    # No 4-cycles
    for i,j,k,l in combinations(range(n), 4):
        solver.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,j)], edges[(j,k)], edges[(k,l)], edges[(l,i)])))
        solver.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,j)], edges[(j,l)], edges[(l,k)], edges[(k,i)])))
        solver.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,k)], edges[(k,j)], edges[(j,l)], edges[(l,i)])))
    
    print("Solving...")
    result = solver.check()
    print(f"Result: {result}")
    if str(result) == "sat":
        model = solver.model()
        edge_list = []
        for (i,j), v in edges.items():
            if z3.is_true(model[v]):
                edge_list.append((i,j))
        return edge_list
    return None
